Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter

Dear Mr. Iyengar,

Thank you for meeting us on 6 May 2019 about your dispute with Suresh Hegde. As we understand it, the tenant has sublet the flat without permission. The matter is listed before the Thiruvananthapuram District Court.

Our advice is to collect evidence of unauthorised subletting such as utility bills in the occupant's name. Please collect utility bills in the occupant's name and statements of the neighbours and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 4,50,000.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
